name: add_go_todo_store_query_pagination
description: Add status-filter + offset/limit pagination to an in-memory todo store; broken paginates the UNFILTERED store first then filters, so filter+pagination interact wrongly
prompts: Store in store.go only supports Add and All. Add a Query(status string, offset, limit int) method: status filters to that value ('' means no filter), and offset/limit apply to the FILTERED result set (not the raw, unfiltered store) - skip `offset` MATCHING items, then return up to `limit` of what's left, preserving insertion order. An offset at or past the number of matches returns an empty (non-nil-vs-nil doesn't matter) slice. Keep Add/All unchanged.
